name: Aria Of The Winds

boost.name: Reckless Greed
effect: Once per turn, after resolving an action that does not cause a Strike, you may discard one of your Boosts from play to Strike.
AFTER: You may return a card from your discard pile to your hand.

name: Siren Call

boost.name: Opulence
effect: Your attacks have "HIT: If you have a Continuous Boost in play, +1 Power."
AFTER: If the opponent is stunned, Pull until they are at range 2.

name: Treasure Hunter

boost.name: Treasure Hoarder
effect: Add a card from your hand to your Gauge.
HIT: Push 3 and the opponent discards a card from their gauge. Add the top card of your discard pile to your gauge.

name: Albatross Talon

boost.name: Memories From The Deep
effect: You may play Instant Boosts from your gauge as if they were in your hand. When you do, seal them after they resolve.
HIT: Retreat 2 and draw a card.

name: Symphony Of The Deep

boost.name: Silver Shadow
effect: Move to any space at range 3 from the opponent.
HIT: Return cards at random from your discard pile to your hand until you have 7 in hand. Shuffle your discard pile.

name: Dredge Fury

boost.name: Riptide
effect: Both players draw up to 3 cards. Take another action.
BEFORE: Spend up to 3 Gauge. For each Gauge Spent, +2 Power. Instead of discarding one card spent this way, add it to your hand.
